div.div: رَجُلٌ رَأْرَأٌ and ↓ رَأْرَآءٌ , (T,) or رَأْرَأُالعَيْنِ (S, M) and ↓ رَأْرَاؤُهَا , (Kr, M,) A man who turns about the black of the eye much. (T, S, * M.) And ↓ اِمْرَأَةٌ رَأْرَآءٌ , (T, M, K,) with medd. and without ة, (T,) and رَأْرَأٌ and رَأْرَأَةٌ, (M, K,) A woman who opens her eye wide, (M,) or who glistens with her eyes, (K,) looking sharply, or intently. (M, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
